description: RFC8693 token exchange: try to exchange an access token while lying about subject_token_type; broker should reject or not mint a usable token (prevents type-confusion over-grant).
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must enforce subject_token_type semantics; a subject token must not be accepted under an incompatible token type to mint effective permissions beyond upstream intent.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange accepted a subject token under an incompatible subject_token_type and minted a usable token, risking over-grant via token-type confusion.

description: Attempt to switch into an organization context at refresh time: obtain a refresh token without organization_id, then refresh with organization_id to see if org-scoped permissions are minted without upstream org intent.
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Organization-scoped effective permissions must be bound to upstream intent; a non-org refresh token must not be usable to mint an org-context access token by adding organization_id later.

params.name: org-i5-refresh-switch
params.description: I5 org context switch test org

oracle_checks.violation_description: A refresh token obtained without organization intent was accepted to mint an organization-context token by adding organization_id at refresh time (org context escalation).

description: I5 empty_audience: request token without resource (potentially opaque/default-audience) then attempt to use it as if it were an API-audience JWT; broker must not grant API-bound permissions without explicit upstream intent (resource indicator).
invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must not exceed the upstream intent; omitting the resource indicator must not yield an API-audience JWT or API-bound permissions for https://valence.local/api.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Baseline failed: could not introspect one or both tokens; cannot evaluate audience-binding behavior reliably.
Token minted without resource indicator appears bound to the API audience anyway (or metadata indicates API resource), implying permissions may exceed upstream intent.
Control token requested with explicit resource did not reflect the API audience in introspection metadata; test setup may be misconfigured or audience binding is broken.
